title: Sandkit patches.json
description: Sandkit bundle patches (patches.json). Aligns with @sandustry-modding/types/configs BundlePatchesFile and https://sandustry.com/sandkit.html#patches-heading. Patches break across game updates; prefer sandkit.api when possible.

PatchTargetFile.description: Compiled bundle path under js/. Known targets: js/bundle.js, js/manager-worker.js, js/simulation-worker.js, js/utility-worker.js.

pattern.description: JavaScript regex pattern source (without surrounding / delimiters). Capture groups may be referenced from code as $1, $2, …

flags.description: Optional regex flags (for example g or m).

find.description: Exact source substring to locate in the bundle. Mutually exclusive with regex.

regex.description: Regex-based locator instead of a literal find string.

code.description: Replacement or inserted source text. Official examples use code.

replace.description: Alias of code used by some patch loaders and workshop mods.

expectedMatches.description: How many times find / regex must match. Use a number (often 1) so the load fails on miss or over-match. Some loaders accept "any".

before.description: Text inserted before the match when operation is wrap.

after.description: Text inserted after the match when operation is wrap.

id.description: Optional stable id for logging and tooling.

atomicGroup.description: Group id shared by patches that must all succeed or all fail together.

description.description: Human-readable note for maintainers. Not required by the official schema.
